caption:
Can you want for others what you want for yourself?

The Prophet ﷺ said that none of you will have faith till he wishes for his brother what he likes for himself. Tonight, make dua for someone else with the very thing you hope for.

Sahih al-Bukhari 13 · Grade: Sahih

Name one person you will make that dua for tonight
